name: Set-Theoretic Constraint Masking
description: Replaces the original algebraic divisibility rule with a set-theoretic cardinality constraint on the image of each edge. By defining a collision as the image set {c_u, c_v} having a cardinality of 1, the problem removes the arithmetic affordance that allowed models to build an allowed-pair table via algebraic evaluation. Models that rely on parsing mathematical formulas to identify standard constraints will fail to map this set-theoretic property to a simple graph coloring edge constraint, preventing them from triggering their optimized constraint-satisfaction templates.
